question: Which of the following cells is NOT used in watches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lead-acid cell**__.

__
 
• **The lead-acid cell is NOT used in watches.**__
 
• It is one of the oldest rechargeable batteries.
 
• They are known as secondary batteries.
 
• The chemical reactions that occur in secondary cells are reversible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 **Cell**
 **Details**
 
 

 Zinc-air cell
 
 
 
• They are metal-air batteries powered by oxidizing zinc with oxygen from the air.
 
• *Uses* Hearing aids, film cameras,grid-scale energy storage. 
 
 
 
 

 Silver oxide cell
 
 
 
• It is a primary cell using silver oxide as a cathode and as an anode.
 
• They are *used* in the Apollo program for the lunar module and lunar rover.
 
 
 
 

 Mercury cell
 
 
 
• It is a non-rechargeable electrochemical battery.
 
• It is a primary cell
 
• *Uses* Calculators, watches, hearing aids.
